title: Articles 20–22 and 21A — Life, liberty, education, arrest (subject provision)

content.heading: Conviction; life and personal liberty; education; arrest and detention
content.text: Article 20 protects against ex post facto criminal law, double jeopardy, and compelled self-incrimination. Article 21: no person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law. Article 21A: the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such manner as the State may, by law, determine. Article 22 confers protections regarding arrest and detention in certain cases, including a distinct preventive-detention regime. Canonical texts: provision:india:constitution-art-20, art-21, art-21a, art-22.
